description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #5; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). Adds the Gemini MicroG integration (GmsCore) patch: rewrites the shell DEX GMS strings to the selected MicroG vendor, injects the spoofing meta-data + FAKE_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE + <queries> entry, stubs the GMS availability checks to success and injects checkGmsCore() into the launcher activity — Gemini boots and resolves Play Services through MicroG RE without the Google Play Services app (a Google account is still required for chat). Carries re-cut #4's Gemini permission-strip + privacy patches (docs/GEMINI.md), re-cut #3's all-B*-bridge Mereframe sweep (#34/#35/#29) and re-cut #2's Netflix Android TV support.
